"The renovation turned out better than we ever imagined." Most
renovations go wrong because designers jump straight into
visuals — without understanding who they’re designing for. At
Design 4 Space, that’s never the case. For Shermin, the
process starts with listening. She studies your lifestyle,
habits, routines — even the things you don’t realise matter —
and turns them into design decisions that actually make sense.
The result? A space that looks good, lives even better, and
feels unmistakably yours. Work with someone who gets it right,
from day one. Book your free consultation with Design 4 Space
